title: Skill Management
description: Install, configure, and create skills to extend agent and automation capabilities

steps.title: What are Skills?
steps.description: Skills are reusable packages of prompts, tools, and workflows that agents and automations can use. Like npm packages for AI.

steps.title: Browse Registry
steps.description: Go to Settings → Skills → Registry to see available skills

steps.title: Configure Skill
steps.description: After install, click 'Configure' to set API keys, default params, and permissions

steps.title: Use Skill
steps.description: In Agent chat: 'Create a GitHub issue for the bug I described in note #abc123'

action.value: Create a GitHub issue for the bug I described in note #abc123

steps.title: Create Custom Skill
steps.description: Click 'New Skill' to build your own. Define schema, prompts, and TypeScript tool handlers. Publish to registry.
